source_row_policy: All original daily rows are retained unchanged in the raw archive. Monthly forecast opportunities are selected or excluded; exclusion counts are candidate windows, not original rows.

next_day_specific_discharge.instruction: Predict the river specific discharge for target_date in millimetres per day. The forecast origin is the end of forecast_origin_date. Use the seven supplied daily archive records, which end one day before the origin to allow for daily aggregation timing.
next_day_specific_discharge.field_description: history_columns defines seven chronological daily records. precipitation and potential_evapotranspiration use mm/day; temperature uses degrees Celsius; discharge uses mm/day. The last history date is one day before forecast_origin_date, providing a conservative availability lag for water-day/calendar-day conventions. target_date is the following date after the forecast origin. Static inputs are catchment area (km^2), gauge elevation (m above sea level), latitude/longitude (degrees); null means an unavailable static attribute. No catchment identifier, full-period hydrological statistic, or target-day weather is an input.

grouping_rule: One group per catchment ID. Catchment IDs are provenance only. Groups are not asserted to be spatially independent; nested/nearby catchments may be correlated.
split_policy: Unassigned. For future-time validation, divide by target date and require every history date to remain before its target; reserve a gap of at least 8 days at boundaries. For unseen-catchment evaluation reserve whole catchments and preferably whole river basins/spatial regions. No random row splitting.

sampling.forecast_origins: every calendar month-end in the complete published 1970-10-01 to 2015-09-30 period
sampling.reason: Cover all catchments and all years while limiting near-repeated prompts and source size; this is a deterministic monthly subsample of daily forecasting opportunities, not all daily rows.
sampling.missing_policy: Exclude missing/nonfinite or negative discharge label; exclude incomplete histories; never impute; preserve missing static attributes as null.

quality_findings: Monthly origins are sampled; this does not support unbiased daily-event or flood-frequency evaluation.
Rainfall labelled d may aggregate 09:00 d to 09:00 d+1; NRFA flows may use water days or calendar days. The one-day history lag prevents overlap with the next-day target for these conventions.
Retrospectively revised and spatially processed meteorological archives do not establish real-time operational availability.
Only topographic area and gauge coordinates/elevation are selected; full-period q_mean, runoff ratio, flow quantiles and climate summaries are excluded.
Missing discharge is not zero. Zero flow is retained.
Label is the published discharge_spec in mm/day, not an invented conversion from discharge_vol.
Catchment boundary and flow observation uncertainties remain; neighboring/nested catchments are not independent.
No normalization, imputation, model fitting or training was performed.
